home.rulesSummary: How are wind and rain assessed?
home.rules: Rough assessment from the MET forecast for the launch: more than {maxWind} m/s (or the site's own limit) or gusts above {maxGust} m/s is too much. Light wind, missing gusts, gusts more than {maxGustSpread} m/s above the mean wind, a direction near the edge and light rain (from {rainMaybe} mm in the next hour) give “uncertain”. Rain ({rainNo} mm or more in the next hour) gives “not suitable”. The forecast does not see local conditions. Always check for yourself.

about.title: About the site and privacy
about.description: Who makes HPGT flying sites, where the data comes from, the licences and how the site handles personal data.
about.intro: HPGT flying sites is an overview of paragliding and speedflying sites in the HPGT area, made and maintained by the club's members.
about.responsibility: The overview is a rough guide. The club takes no responsibility for information about safety, airspace or landowner agreements. Every pilot and student decides for themselves whether the site and conditions are OK, and always checks airspace and NOTAM in IPPC before flying.
about.wind: The wind assessment is a rough assessment from the MET forecast for each launch. It does not see local conditions, and never says it is «OK to fly».
about.credit: The site builds on Lars Sletten's old site guide, which he has given to the club.
about.sourcesIntro: Each site page shows at the bottom which sources the site is based on, and what each field comes from under «Details». The data comes from:
about.sourceKartverket: maps, heights and elevation profiles (CC BY 4.0).
about.sourceOpenaip: airspace over the launches (CC BY-NC 4.0). Not for navigation.
about.sourceMet: the wind forecast for each launch and measurements from MET's weather stations near the flying sites (CC BY 4.0), and the meteograms from Yr (delivered by NRK and MET).
about.sourceHolfuy: measured wind, temperature and pressure from the weather stations, on the weather page and the site pages.
about.sourceFlightlog: launch coordinates and directions for many sites, and links to the sites there.
about.sourceMaps: Map layers: OpenTopoMap and OpenStreetMap contributors (CC BY-SA), satellite imagery from Sentinel-2 cloudless by EOX (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), thermals from thermal.kk7.ch (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and precipitation radar from RainViewer.
about.sourceLocal: Local knowledge from the club's members, and walking routes logged with GPS on the way up.
about.sourcePhotos: Photos: the photographer and licence are below the photos on each site page.
about.sourcesNote: The credits the maps and licences require are also shown with the data itself: in the map, below the airspace figure and below the photos.
about.privacyStats: The site counts visits anonymously with {goatcounter}, without cookies. It counts which pages are visited and some clicks (for example tabs, filters and map layers), not who visits them.
about.privacySearch: What you type in the search field is never sent anywhere. Searches without hits are only counted as a number.
about.privacyStorage: Your choices for colour mode and colour-blind-friendly colours are only stored in your browser. Once you have visited a page, the browser may store it and the map tiles you have seen, so it works offline.
about.privacyThirdParty: Maps, satellite imagery, thermals, radar and the Yr meteogram are loaded from the services that make them, and they see your IP address, as with any website. The fonts are served from the site itself.
about.privacyReport: «Report a change» on the site pages sends what you write to the club as a public issue on GitHub, with your name only if you write it. Cloudflare Turnstile checks that it is not a robot, and is loaded only when you open the form. The data service stores only how many reports were sent that day.
about.privacyData: The forecast and the measurements are fetched from the club's own data service on Cloudflare, which sees your IP address like other websites. It stores only weather data (the measurements for 7 days, older ones in an archive), nothing about you.
about.privacyNoAccount: The site has no login and no forms, and stores no personal data about you.
about.changes: Use the form at the bottom of the site's page, or {form} in the menu for what does not concern one site. It becomes an issue for the club, without you needing an account. You can also tell someone in the club, or open an issue yourself on {github}.
about.sourceOgn: pilots and aircraft in the air in the map layer «Pilots in the air», from FANET and FLARM devices (ODbL). Pilots who have opted out in OGN are not shown, and those who do not want to be identified are shown as «Unknown». Nothing is stored.

report.intro: A new landing, a closed road, a new hazard or something wrong? Write briefly what and where. It becomes an issue for the club, which checks before the site is changed.
report.messageHint: 10–1000 characters. Do not write phone numbers or anything you do not want public.

report.privacy: What you write becomes a public issue on GitHub. Cloudflare Turnstile checks that you are not a robot.
report.pageDescription: Tell HPGT about a new flying site, an error on the site, an idea or anything else.
report.pageIntro: Do you know a flying site that is missing, have you found an error, or do you have an idea? Write briefly, and the club gets an issue to follow up. If it concerns one flying site, it is easiest to report at the bottom of that site's page.
